grain_rationale: One source row is one scheduled flight leg departing a New York airport, so the grain is transaction. The profile reports row_count 166158 and duplicate_row_rate 0.0, so no exact duplicate rows exist and no roll-up is needed to make rows distinct. No single column is unique on its own (the largest distinct_count among candidate keys is tail_number at 3825 and flight_number at 2994, both far below 166158), so the identity is derived over the ordered tuple flight_date, carrier_code, flight_number, origin_airport, dest_airport, sched_dep_hhmm, which is the combination that pins one scheduled leg on one service day; because duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 there are no exact duplicates for that tuple to absorb.

fields.name: flight_date
fields.description: Service date of the flight leg, spanning min 2013-01-01 to max 2013-06-30 across 181 distinct days with null_rate 0.0, used here as the calendar label of the leg rather than as the event timestamp.

fields.name: carrier_code
fields.description: Two-letter operating carrier code with 16 distinct values such as 9E, AA, DL and WN and null_rate 0.0, labelling the airline that operated the leg.

fields.name: flight_number
fields.description: Carrier-assigned flight number ranging 1 to 8500 over 2994 distinct values with null_rate 0.0; it is an identifier stored as a number and is never added across rows, so it is a dimension.

fields.name: origin_airport
fields.description: Departure airport code limited to the three distinct values EWR, JFK and LGA with null_rate 0.0, identifying the New York-area origin of the leg.

fields.name: sched_dep_hhmm
fields.description: Scheduled departure clock time encoded as HHMM between 500 and 2359 over 969 distinct values with null_rate 0.0; the number is a time label and not additive, so it is a dimension.

fields.name: dest_airport
fields.description: Destination airport code over 100 distinct values sampled as ABQ, ACK, ALB, ATL and BNA with null_rate 0.0, identifying where the leg terminated.

fields.name: tail_number
fields.description: Registration of the airframe flown, with 3825 distinct values sampled as N10156 and N102UW; it is nullable at null_rate 0.009154 because some rows, including cancelled flights, carry no assigned airframe.

fields.name: is_cancelled
fields.description: Flag with the two distinct values false and true and null_rate 0.0, marking legs that were cancelled rather than operated.

fields.name: dep_hhmm
fields.description: Actual departure clock time encoded as HHMM between 1 and 2400 over 1291 distinct values; it labels a time of day rather than measuring a quantity, and is nullable at null_rate 0.029388 because legs that never departed have no actual departure time.

fields.name: dep_delay_minutes
fields.description: Departure delay in minutes ranging -33 (early) to 1301, a quantity that is averaged and compared across legs; it is nullable at null_rate 0.029388, matching the rows with no actual departure time.

fields.name: arr_hhmm
fields.description: Actual arrival clock time encoded as HHMM between 1 and 2400 over 1392 distinct values, a time-of-day label rather than a measure, nullable at null_rate 0.0307 for legs that never arrived.

fields.name: sched_arr_hhmm
fields.description: Scheduled arrival clock time encoded as HHMM between 1 and 2359 over 1134 distinct values with null_rate 0.0; it is a published schedule label, not an additive quantity.

fields.name: arr_delay_minutes
fields.description: Arrival delay in minutes ranging -86 to 1272, a quantity summed and averaged across legs; nullable at null_rate 0.032981 for legs with no recorded arrival.

fields.name: air_time_minutes
fields.description: Minutes airborne ranging 20 to 695, an additive quantity for utilisation analysis; nullable at null_rate 0.032981 because cancelled or diverted legs record no air time.

fields.name: distance_miles
fields.description: Great-circle distance of the leg in statute miles ranging 80 to 4983 with null_rate 0.0, summed across legs to give miles flown.

fields.name: sched_dep_hour_local
fields.description: Local scheduled departure hour taking the 19 distinct values 5 through 23 with null_rate 0.0, a time-of-day bucket used to group legs.

fields.name: sched_dep_minute_local
fields.description: Local scheduled departure minute ranging 0 to 59 over 60 distinct values with null_rate 0.0, a clock component used for grouping rather than a measure.

fields.name: departure_hour_utc
fields.description: UTC timestamp of the scheduled departure hour, spanning 2013-01-01T10:00:00 to 2013-07-01T03:00:00 over 3439 distinct values with null_rate 0.0; every sample lands on an exact hour, so it timestamps each leg at hour resolution.

fields.name: carrier_name
fields.description: Full operating carrier name with 16 distinct values such as Delta Air Lines Inc. and JetBlue Airways and null_rate 0.0, the descriptive counterpart of carrier_code.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacturer
fields.description: Manufacturer of the airframe over 34 distinct values sampled as AIRBUS, BOEING and BOMBARDIER INC; nullable at null_rate 0.160426 because many legs have no matching aircraft registry record.

fields.name: aircraft_model
fields.description: Aircraft model designation over 121 distinct values sampled as 172M and 421C; nullable at null_rate 0.160426, the same rows that lack manufacturer detail.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacture_year
fields.description: Year the airframe was manufactured, ranging 1956 to 2013 over 46 distinct values; it labels the aircraft vintage rather than measuring anything, and is nullable at null_rate 0.176531 where registry data is missing.

fields.name: aircraft_seat_count
fields.description: Seats installed on the airframe, ranging 2 to 450 over 47 distinct values, a capacity quantity that is summed or averaged across legs; nullable at null_rate 0.160426 where the aircraft registry record is missing.

fields.name: aircraft_engine_type
fields.description: Engine family of the airframe with six distinct values including Turbo-fan, Turbo-jet and Turbo-prop; nullable at null_rate 0.160426 for legs without registry detail.

fields.name: origin_airport_name
fields.description: Full name of the origin airport with the three distinct values John F. Kennedy International Airport, LaGuardia Airport and Newark Liberty International Airport and null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: origin_municipality
fields.description: City of the origin airport with the two distinct values New York and Newark and null_rate 0.0, a geographic label for the departure point.

fields.name: origin_elevation_ft
fields.description: Field elevation of the origin airport in feet with only the three distinct values 13, 18 and 21 and null_rate 0.0; it is a fixed airport attribute that labels rather than measures the leg.

fields.name: origin_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Longest runway at the origin airport in feet with the three distinct values 7002, 11000 and 14511 and null_rate 0.0, a static airport characteristic used for grouping.

fields.name: dest_airport_name
fields.description: Full name of the destination airport over 99 distinct values sampled as Boston Logan International Airport; nullable at null_rate 0.02089 where the destination code has no matching airport reference record.

fields.name: dest_municipality
fields.description: City of the destination airport over 95 distinct values sampled as Atlanta and Albuquerque; nullable at null_rate 0.02089, consistent with the unmatched destination reference rows.

fields.name: dest_iso_region
fields.description: ISO region code of the destination over 45 distinct values sampled as US-CA and PR-U-A, used for state-level grouping; nullable at null_rate 0.02089 for unmatched destinations.

fields.name: dest_elevation_ft
fields.description: Field elevation of the destination airport in feet ranging 3 to 6606, a static airport attribute that labels the arrival point; nullable at null_rate 0.02089 for unmatched destinations.

fields.name: dest_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Longest runway at the destination airport in feet ranging 5076 to 16000, a static airport characteristic rather than a leg quantity; nullable at null_rate 0.02089 for unmatched destinations.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: Capture timestamp of the silver load, confined to 16 distinct values between 2026-09-02T23:25:51 and 2026-09-02T23:26:06 with null_rate 0.0; it describes the load batch, not the flight, so it is a dimension and not the event time.

category_description: One row is one scheduled flight leg departing an origin airport on a given service date, identified by the combination of service date, operating carrier, flight number, origin, destination and scheduled departure time, and timestamped at the UTC hour of scheduled departure. Each row carries the operating and schedule attributes of the leg, the airframe and airport reference attributes joined to it, and the delay, air time, distance and seat-capacity quantities observed for it.
purpose: This mapping declares how silver.silver_flights enters the gold unified event star as the flight_legs fact category: which column timestamps the event and at what grain, which combination of columns identifies one leg, and what role each silver column plays as time, dimension or measure. Its consumer is the deterministic modeling engine, which reads the contract and generates the gold models; no analyst or query reads this contract directly.
usage: The proposal is rendered into an ODCS mapping contract draft, validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, linted, and reviewed and edited by a human before approval. Once approved, the modeling engine uses it to emit the gold models for flight_legs; changing the grain, the time column or any field role here changes the generated models, so edits go through the same review and gating path.
limitations: The mapping only names silver columns and the identity tuple over them; it performs no transformation, so the HHMM clock-time integers (sched_dep_hhmm, dep_hhmm, arr_hhmm, sched_arr_hhmm) stay encoded as profiled and are not converted to timestamps, and the time grain is hour because every departure_hour_utc sample lands on an exact hour, so finer departure timing must come from the HHMM columns. It declares no filter: cancelled legs (is_cancelled true, with dep_hhmm, dep_delay_minutes, arr_delay_minutes and air_time_minutes null at rates 0.029388 to 0.032981) remain in the fact and their exclusion is left to consumers, as are the rows lacking aircraft registry detail (null_rate 0.160426 to 0.176531) and the rows lacking destination airport reference detail (null_rate 0.02089). It also carries no quality rules, classifications, ownership or service levels, which review owns.
